newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japanese net foreign bond buyers in December.
newsitem.headline: Japanese net foreign bond buyers in December.

text.p: Net purchases of foreign bonds by Japanese investors totalled 1.3466 trillion yen in December after net purchases of 1.2058 trillion yen a month earlier, the Ministry of Finance (MOF) said on Monday.
Bonds include beneficiary certificates but exclude all bills.
Net buying of Japanese stocks by foreign investors amounted to 294.1 billion yen in December compared with net sales of 14.3 billion yen in the previous month, the ministry said.
Details of Japanese and foreigners' investments in billions of yen, were as follows:

Japanese stocks: Net Japanese bonds: Net
Figures are rounded and based on settlements.
